pulse.label: Worker 2 - Pulse
pulse.description: Top trending products selling in South Africa right now

data.product: Mobile Phone Accessories (Chargers, Covers, Wireless Earphones)
data.trend_reason: SA consumers love gadgets; remote work and online classes drive demand. High Takealot volume.
data.source: iKhokha High Demand Products SA / Takealot best-sellers

data.trend_reason: Glow-up culture booming in Mzansi. High repeat purchase, strong social media influence.
Air fryers remain the MVP in SA households. Strong home-office lifestyle shift driving sales.
Growing birth rates + premium spending on infants. Steady demand with no downturn foreseen.
Hybrid/remote work still prevalent. Desks, chairs, ergonomic products flying off shelves.

radar.label: Worker 3 - Radar
radar.description: Most in-demand jobs and skills in South Africa this week

data.details: 118,000 unfilled digital roles nationally. 37% vacancy rate. AI, data engineering, cybersecurity and cloud computing hardest to fill. Junior devs earn R300K-R600K/yr.
data.source: Edstellar / OfferZen State of SA Developer Nation 2025

data.details: Only 15,000 registered engineers for 62M people. 38% of employers couldn't find engineers in 2025. Triple-digit vacancy growth in civil/structural roles.
SA projected to be short 97,000 health workers. Losing 5,900 doctors/nurses per year from public facilities. NHI rollout will further spike demand.
data.source: Edstellar / Dept of Health Nursing Shortage Report

data.skill: Renewable Energy (Solar PV, Wind, Battery Storage)
data.details: SAREM targeting 3-5 GW new renewables per year. 86,531 FTE jobs created. 25,000 new jobs targeted by 2030. Strong demand for solar installers.
35,000 unfilled cybersecurity positions. Market growing 20% by 2025. 80% of SA companies hit by cyberattacks costing R2.2B/yr. POPIA compliance driving demand.

hawk.label: Worker 4 - Hawk
hawk.description: Overpriced products and market gaps in South Africa

data.details: Most cybersecurity firms target enterprise. SA SMEs pay premium or go unprotected. Over 1,000 ransomware attacks/month. Gap: affordable, packaged cybersecurity for small businesses.
data.source: Lula / Interpol Africa Cyber Assessment Report

data.details: South Africa faces a 2.2M property gap market. Affordable student housing, co-working spaces and eco-friendly housing developments are massively underserved.
data.opportunity_size: Massive — R80B+ opportunity in real estate/property

data.details: SA online grocery market projected at R80 billion by 2026. Yet last-mile delivery in townships and peri-urban areas is almost nonexistent. Huge gap for local e-commerce fulfilment.
84% of SA large companies struggle to find skilled talent. Only 15,000 engineers for 62M people. Affordable online upskilling and certification programs massively underserved.
data.opportunity_size: Large — skills gap across all sectors

data.details: SA government pushing circular economy. E-waste collection in suburban and township areas almost non-existent. Industrial recycling infrastructure underdeveloped.
data.source: Lula Business Ideas SA / Engineering News

echo.label: Worker 5 - Echo
echo.description: Top SA business news stories this week (July 2026)

data.headline: Big changes coming for electricity prices in South Africa
data.summary: Eskom and NERSA signalling major electricity tariff restructuring. Businesses facing new cost models as SA's energy grid transitions post-load-shedding.

data.headline: United States tariffs push R1 billion factory to shut down in South Africa
data.summary: US trade tariffs forcing manufacturing closures. SA businesses feeling the squeeze from global trade wars. Cabinet approving key protective policies.

data.headline: Cabinet approves key policies on critical matters
data.summary: Cabinet policy approvals covering expropriation, Special Economic Zones targeting R750B investment, and infrastructure spending of R46.7B over 3 years.

data.headline: South African crypto giant cutting 20% of jobs
data.summary: Luno (major SA crypto exchange) cutting 20% of workforce amid market challenges. Signal of crypto sector consolidation in SA.

data.headline: Good news about US tariffs on South Africa & SA rand eases on inflation data
data.summary: Positive tariff developments for SA exports. SA Rand weakened ahead of July inflation reading and SARB monetary policy meeting. Inflation accelerated to 5% in June.

vibe.label: Worker 6 - Vibe
vibe.description: Viral trends on South African social media this week

data.details: Brands in SA experimenting with synthetic influencers and AI-powered content creation. July 2026 saw major uptick in AI-generated product posts and brand AI avatars.
data.source: Econsultancy Social Media Trends July 2026 / Hootsuite

data.details: Trending transition video format: drawing/sketching something that morphs into real-life footage. Hugely viral in SA creator community in July 2026.
With Football World Cup 2026 in full swing (hosted in US/Canada/Mexico), SA Twitter/X extremely active with Bafana Bafana support content, watch parties and fan reactions.
SA brands adopting serialised content formats - multi-episode brand stories on Instagram and LinkedIn. Drives follow-through engagement. Growing among SA SME brands.
Woolworths' viral 1kg 'Avozilla' avocado taking SA social media by storm. Reaction videos, cooking challenges, and unboxings dominating SA TikTok this week.

data.details: KwaZulu-Natal Legislature and other state entities continuously tender for cybersecurity, ERP upgrades, server monitoring, and IT security critical controls implementation. 6-month and 3-year contracts.
